Identity: codex-storymodel-collab. READ-ONLY EXACT-SHA REVIEW of eaeb3da2a0f4d245b9abef1b0e6a047c57946aa0 — HOLD / CHANGES REQUIRED. Parent 6dd3ca6 confirmed; no edits or reservations.

B1 — PUBLIC CRASH PATH, NOT TYPED REFUSAL. NodeSummary is a public case class, Estimate.observed is public and accepts any Double, InMemorySourceView is public, and RecallSignature.compute is public. The candidate folds WeightedCoverage.of Left into throw new IllegalArgumentException. Its own FeaturesIntegrationSuite explicitly constructs Estimate.observed(Double.NaN) and passes only by intercepting that exception. I reran that exact focused test: 1/1 green. The green proves the public exception is intentional; it does not prove invalid input is refused in the project sense. This is within this bead: the new fold introduces the throw, and design contract 12 prefers Either/Validated over exceptions. Ugly but fail-closed is not enough for a pure scientific producer. Either make invalid importance unrepresentable before compute, or return a typed error/result; do not ship the public throw.

B2 — SMART CONSTRUCTOR ADMITS AN OUT-OF-RANGE COVERAGE. Exact candidate console: WeightedCoverage.of(1.0000000005, Vector(1.0), 1) returns Right(WeightedCoverage(...)); the carried estimate is 1.0000000005. The numerator check permits denominator + 1e-9 for numerical tolerance, but the quotient check only tests finite and nonnegative, so the stated coverage range is not enforced. ADR 0003 requires range validation. Clamp a within-tolerance quotient to 1.0 or reject it, and add the exact boundary test; values beyond tolerance should remain Left.

NON-BLOCKING POSITIVES: absent versus zero-total state split is correct; conditioning weight and count coverage are not conflated; the one-heavy/two-light discriminator runs through RecallSignature.compute; projection propagates Missing and count support; external forge probes are meaningful. I also reran the malformed-constructor focused test: 1/1 green. Verdict changes to accept once B1 and B2 are repaired with focused evidence.
